source_resolution: metadataSource is a required exact enum: api-return/api-throw/not-started/unknown. Actual API return/catch is its source; trace and markers cannot invent it.

completed/refused schema branches require api-return, workerKind=ok, null errorName/errorCode and signal=null. Refused requires a safe nonzero returned integer. The former refused/status1/launch-error/EIO counterexample, and errorCode=EIO alone, are rejected.

api-throw has no API return status/signal. Timeout requires actual timeout class, workerKind=timeout and null status/signal/code. The former timeout/status0/EIO counterexample and invented signal are rejected.

Only actual BoundedSubprocessLaunchError.code may map to a nonnull safe error code; absent code maps to null. Frozen timeout/output/supervision error classes have no such code. Unsupported or diagnostic errors are unknown, never renamed as product API errors.

The frozen API returns native status/signal only at line111; its worker constructs the ok status/signal from native close at lines84-89. Guard and trace attach exit/close callbacks to the same returned ChildProcess handle and serialize those callback status/signal fields.

All four unique guard/trace native child-exit/child-close facts must be present, owned by the same admitted native childPid/worker/case/root/script and mutually equal; normal returns must also equal the API status/signal. A Node worker spawn-sync status is explicitly excluded as native status.

Throw-path exit/close facts remain independently observed ownership/consistency facts; they cannot fill unavailable API return fields. A frozen API watchdog timeout without matching workerKind=timeout cannot qualify as clean timeout.

Missing/duplicate/contradictory source/error/worker/admission/exit-close relations require unknown, raw-protocol rejection, safe rebuild and no T1/T2 progression. The unchanged selection table only permits clean T1 empty-prefix or T2 json-enter-only refusal/timeout; markers cannot override uncertainty.
